seoTitle: The 100 Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The 100 test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Clarke, Bellamy, Octavia, Raven, Murphy, Jasper, Monty or Lexa — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the reluctant leader, the fearless warrior, or the survivor who always finds a way? Answer 12 everyday questions about loyalty, survival and impossible choices, and find out which character from The 100 you are.

characters.name: Clarke Griffin
characters.title: The Reluctant Leader
characters.summary: Compassionate, clever and willing to make the hard calls. You carry the weight so other people don't have to.
description: Like Clarke, you step up when nobody else will. She's the effective leader of the 100 and their main medic.
You'll do what has to be done. Clarke is caring at heart, but she can be ruthless to protect her people.
You carry the weight. After the battle of Mount Weather, Clarke becomes known as Wanheda, the Commander of Death.
characters.flaw: You make the impossible choices yourself, then never forgive yourself for them.
characters.signature: A medical kit, a heavy heart and a decision nobody else could make.
characters.clashReason: they'd make the big decision without asking you

characters.name: Bellamy Blake
characters.title: The Protector
characters.summary: Passionate, protective and driven by your heart. You'd go to war for the people you love.
description: Like Bellamy, you'd do anything for your family. He's fiercely protective of his younger sister, Octavia.
You lead with your heart. Bellamy is co-leader of the 100, and he grows from a hot-headed rebel into a real leader.
You feel your mistakes deeply. Bellamy often carries guilt over choices he's made, and tries hard to make up for them.
characters.flaw: You act on emotion first and deal with the guilt later.
characters.signature: A jacket, a gun you'd rather not use and a sister you'd die for.
characters.clashReason: they'd protect you so hard you'd never get to make your own choices

characters.name: Octavia Blake
characters.title: The Warrior
characters.summary: Wild, independent and fierce. You've been told your whole life to hide, and you're done hiding.
description: Like Octavia, you refuse to be kept down. She grew up hidden under the floor on the Ark, because second children were forbidden.
You find your own way. On the ground, Octavia trains as a Grounder warrior and becomes one of the fiercest fighters there is.
You've gone dark, and come back. Octavia rules ruthlessly as Blodreina, the Red Queen, before fighting for her own redemption.
characters.flaw: When you're angry, you can become someone you don't recognise.
characters.signature: A sword, war paint and a life nobody else gets to control.
characters.clashReason: they'd fight you on everything, just because they could

characters.name: Raven Reyes
characters.title: The Genius Mechanic
characters.summary: Brilliant, stubborn and fearless. If it's broken, you'll fix it, and if it's impossible, you'll do it anyway.
description: Like Raven, you're the smartest person in the room, and you know it. She's a zero-gravity mechanic and engineer.
You don't give up. Raven is brave, ambitious and stubborn, and nothing has ever stopped her for long.
You keep everyone alive. Raven handles communications and builds whatever the group needs, from radios to bombs.
characters.flaw: You're so stubborn that you'd rather struggle alone than accept help.
characters.signature: A toolbelt, a radio you built yourself and a solution nobody else saw.
characters.clashReason: they'd take apart everything you own to see how it works

characters.name: John Murphy
characters.title: The Survivor
characters.summary: Sarcastic, cynical and always looking out for number one. But you're more loyal than you let on.
description: Like Murphy, you always survive. He's a former troublemaker who's pragmatic about everything, especially staying alive.
You switch sides when you have to. Murphy shifts his loyalties to protect himself, and the people he loves.
You're better than people think. For all his sarcasm, Murphy turns out to be a lot more loyal than anyone expected.
characters.flaw: You'd sell anyone out to save yourself, at least at first.
characters.signature: A sarcastic comment, an escape route and a soft spot you'd never admit to.
characters.clashReason: they'd switch sides the second it suited them

characters.name: Jasper Jordan
characters.title: The Joker
characters.summary: Goofy, fun-loving and the life of the camp. You make people laugh, even when things are falling apart.
description: Like Jasper, you're the fun one. He's a goofy, geeky chemist and Monty's best friend.
You keep spirits up. Jasper is the one throwing parties and cracking jokes, even on a dangerous planet.
You feel things deeply. Underneath the jokes, Jasper struggles badly with everything he's been through.
characters.flaw: You hide real pain behind jokes until nobody can see it.
characters.signature: Goggles, a homemade brew and a joke for every disaster.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn everything into a joke, even when it's serious

characters.name: Monty Green
characters.title: The Quiet Heart
characters.summary: Gentle, clever and loyal. You'd rather find a better way than take the easy one.
description: Like Monty, you're smart and steady. He's a tech-savvy teen with a talent for science and engineering.
You're valued by everyone. Monty's skills keep the group going, and his calm keeps them together.
You're the moral centre. Monty always looks for the kinder way through, even when everyone else has given up on it.
characters.flaw: You hold onto hope for so long that it hurts you.
characters.signature: A laptop, a handful of seeds and a better plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd refuse to give up on people you've already written off

characters.name: Lexa
characters.title: The Commander
characters.summary: Calm, strategic and fiercely disciplined. You put duty above everything, even your own heart.
description: Like Lexa, you lead from the front. She's the Commander of the Grounders, the leader of all the clans.
You think strategically. Lexa is calm, controlled and always thinking several moves ahead.
You keep your feelings in check, mostly. Lexa believes feelings are a weakness, but her bond with Clarke changes her, and helps bring their people closer.
characters.flaw: You'd sacrifice your own happiness for your duty without a second thought.
characters.signature: War paint, a throne and a heart you keep under lock and key.
characters.clashReason: they'd put the mission before you, every time

questions.text: You start a new job with no training at all. You...

options.text: Take charge. Somebody has to
Work out how everything works by taking it apart
Look busy and do as little as possible
Make friends with everyone and hope it all works out

questions.text: Someone younger you look out for gets into serious trouble. You...

options.text: Drop everything. Protecting them is your whole job
Tell them to fight their own battles. You had to
Calmly help them work out how to fix it
Let them face the consequences. It's how they'll learn

questions.text: Your group has to make an impossible choice. You...

options.text: Make the call yourself, so nobody else has to carry it
Choose what's best for the most people, and don't look back
Look for a third option nobody's thought of
Go with your gut, then wrestle with it afterwards

questions.text: Something breaks right before a big trip. You...

options.text: Fix it in ten minutes with a paperclip and some tape
Turn the broken bits into something that goes bang
Say it's not your problem, and pack lighter
Go without it. You don't need it

questions.text: Someone you trusted betrays you. You...

options.text: Get even. Brutally
Shrug. You'd probably have done the same
Feel it deeply, then try to understand why they did it
Cut them off. You should never have trusted them

questions.text: It's Friday night with your friends. You...

options.text: Throw a party with a drink you brewed yourself
Keep everyone out of trouble. Mostly
Spend it worrying about tomorrow
Head somewhere nobody's ever been

questions.text: You make a mistake that hurts people. You...

options.text: Own it, and use it to do better next time
Make it right, whatever it costs you
Struggle to forgive yourself, and hide it behind jokes
Explain why it wasn't really your fault

questions.text: Someone says you can't do something because of who you are. You...

options.text: Prove them wrong, then rub it in
Get angry, and use it
Agree, then do it anyway when nobody's looking
Let it go. You know what you're worth

questions.text: You fall for someone from the other side. You...

options.text: Hide it. Feelings get in the way of duty
Follow your heart, but never forget your people
Go for it, whatever anyone thinks
Keep it to yourself and throw yourself into work

questions.text: Your group is arguing over who should be in charge. You...

options.text: Step up, even if half of them hate you for it
Back whoever's most likely to keep you alive
Suggest you all lead together
Say you'll follow anyone, as long as you don't have to make the decisions

questions.text: You're one of 100 teenagers sent down to a dangerous, abandoned Earth. The first thing you do is...

options.text: Tell everyone the old rules don't apply down here
Find water, food and shelter, in that order
Run straight into the river. You're finally free
Start rigging up a way to contact home

questions.text: You lead your people, and the only way to save them is to sacrifice another group. You...

options.text: Make the sacrifice. That's what leading means
Do it, and live with what you've done
Refuse to believe there's no other way
Make sure you end up on the side that survives
